title: AI engineering with Repo Explorer
description: Five chapters explain the work of an AI engineer through a repository assistant: selecting evidence with RAG, connecting models with LangChain, controlling execution with LangGraph, and examining the answers in a working interface.
evidence_note: Chapters one through four use offline demo screenshots. Chapter five includes actual Codex-backed responses. The retrieval chapter also records local learned-embedding experiments on authored examples and pinned public package code. Broader evaluation and independent review remain open; this series is an unpublished draft.

articles.title: Building Repo Explorer: the work of an AI engineer
articles.description: Follow a concrete question through the decisions about evidence, models, workflow, and evaluation; see where RAG, LangChain, and LangGraph fit.

articles.title: From source files to useful evidence
articles.description: Compare lexical and local learned retrieval on pinned code, inspecting recovered evidence, ambiguity, and failures.

articles.title: A review that survives closing the browser
articles.description: Use LangGraph interrupts and SQLite checkpoints to represent a durable human-review decision.

articles.title: An interface for inspecting an answer
articles.description: Design a source explorer, workflow trace, and responsive reading surface around observable application behavior.

articles.title: Evaluating live answers against their sources
articles.description: Inspect real model responses, trace incomplete explanations to their evidence, and use observed failures to guide the next engineering decision.
